My dear [Maggie](../persons.html#83)
I wish you many happy returns of the day, and I wish I was sending you a [Daisy Chain](../books.html#24) with it, but I did not write a letter in time to get it from London, so I am afraid you must wait for it till the next day, but it will be something to look forward to then, and I will write your name in it, if you like on Friday evening
your affectionate godmother

C M Yonge

[^1]: Maggie Moberly was born in 1852 and The Daisy Chain seems most likely to have been offered her after the age of 8 and before the age of 18.
